summary: Aircraft Detail View — Fuel Capacity Display
description: As a dispatcher, I want to see the fuel capacity of an aircraft on its detail view so that I can plan fueling operations.

acs.text: The aircraft detail view displays the Maximum Fuel Capacity field in liters.
The fuel capacity value is read-only and cannot be edited on this view.
If the aircraft record has no fuel capacity value, the field displays a dash (—).

questions: What is the source of the fuel capacity data — is it pulled from a separate fuel management API or stored locally in the aircraft record?
Should fuel capacity be displayed in liters, gallons, or configurable per user preference?
comments: PO (2026-05-10): The fuel capacity unit question is still open — waiting on decision from ops team.
Dev (2026-05-12): The dependency on FUEL-API-001 is not resolved yet. This story may be blocked.
